vintage: GUS population 31 December 2025; demographic rates and life expectancy 2025; university students 31 December 2025; territorial division 1 January 2026; PKW: presidential election 2025 (rounds of 18 May and 1 June 2025); Sejm 2023 (15 Oct 2023)

lenses.name: Density
lenses.description: Residents per km² (GUS, 31 December 2025; area on 1 January 2026). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of residents, worked out from the GUS five-year age groups of 31 December 2025 by linear interpolation inside the group that holds the middle resident. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Change 2015-2025
lenses.description: Population on 31 December 2025 ÷ population on 31 December 2015 - 1 (GUS). Each year is on its own borders: a gmina whose borders changed (Opole in 2017, Kamienica and Supraśl in 2025) shows that change too. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: A few gminas changed borders since 2015 (Opole, Kamienica, Supraśl): their change includes that.

lenses.name: Net migration
lenses.description: People who moved in minus people who moved out, within Poland and from abroad, per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Aged 65+
lenses.description: Residents aged 65 or more ÷ all residents (GUS, 31 December 2025). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Births
lenses.description: Live births per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Ukrainians (PESEL UKR)
lenses.description: Ukrainian citizens with a PESEL UKR number (temporary protection) registered in the powiat, per 1,000 residents. The register shows where the number was issued, not where the person lives now. Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per powiat. Counts where the PESEL UKR number was issued, not where people live now.

lenses.name: PIT revenue per person
lenses.description: The gmina's share of personal income tax planned for 2026 ÷ residents (Ministry of Finance, GUS population of 31 December 2025). It follows residents' taxable incomes. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Follows the taxable income of residents.

lenses.name: Average wage
lenses.description: Average gross monthly wage, by employer seat (GUS wage distribution, May 2026). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: Registered unemployment rate, end of October 2026 (GUS). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: New dwellings
lenses.description: Dwellings completed in 2025 per 1,000 residents (GUS). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Higher education
lenses.description: Residents aged 13 or more with a higher-education diploma (NSP 2021 census, 31 March 2021). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: University students
lenses.description: Students of the universities in the gmina, per 1,000 residents (GUS, 31 December 2025). A student on two programmes counts twice. Gminas without a university are blank. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Only gminas with a university have a value.

lenses.name: Tourist nights
lenses.description: Nights spent in tourist accommodation with 10 or more beds in 2025 ÷ residents (GUS). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Doctors
lenses.description: Doctors counted at their main place of work, per 10,000 residents (GUS, 2024). City powiats with big hospitals rank high, the rural powiats around them low. Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per powiat. Counted at the hospital or clinic, so city powiats rank high.

lenses.name: Life expectancy, women
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth of women (GUS, 2025). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Life expectancy, men
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth of men (GUS, 2025). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Roman Catholic
lenses.description: Residents who declared the Roman Catholic Church, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census). About a fifth of residents (21% in Poland) did not answer the voluntary question. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: The census question was voluntary: about a fifth of residents did not answer.

lenses.name: No religion
lenses.description: Residents who declared no religion, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: The census question was voluntary: about a fifth of residents did not answer.

lenses.name: Mass attendance
lenses.description: Dominicantes: the share of Catholics obliged to attend who were at Sunday Mass on the October 2024 count (ISKK, Annuarium Statisticum Ecclesiae in Polonia). Published per Catholic diocese: every gmina shows the diocese of its seat. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: President 2025
lenses.description: Second round, 1 June 2025: Karol Nawrocki's share of valid votes (PKW). The rest went to Rafał Trzaskowski.
lenses.note: Colours split at 50%: teal leans to Trzaskowski, amber to Nawrocki.

lenses.name: Turnout 2025
lenses.description: Valid ballot papers ÷ eligible voters, presidential election second round, 1 June 2025 (PKW). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Sejm 2023
lenses.description: The committee with the most valid votes in the gmina, Sejm election of 15 October 2023 (PKW).
lenses.note: Shows only the committee with the most votes.

lenses.name: PM2.5
lenses.description: Annual mean of PM2.5 in 2025 at the nearest GIOŚ measuring station within 25 km of the gmina's centre. Gminas with no station that close are blank. A station measures its street or district, not the whole gmina. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: The nearest station within 25 km. Blank: no station that close.

lenses.name: 2024 flood
lenses.description: Gminas named in the state of natural disaster declared for the September 2024 flood (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1365 and amendments).
lenses.note: A declaration is a legal act that unlocks aid, not a measure of damage.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land with tree cover (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in cropland or in meadow and pasture below 900 m (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is built up (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
